name: The Family Housemaid

gender_note.quote: He took me for his housemaid

base_age_note.reason: Not described anywhere; a typical age for a single housemaid in an 1862 household.

hair.style: pinned up tight in a small bun, fully tucked under a white cap
hair.reason: No description in the source (she is never on screen in the text); auburn chosen so she never reads as a relative of the brown-haired sisters.

skin.tone: fair, freckled, rosy cheeks; hands reddened from work

marks.reason: 1862 servant's uniform; the visual anchor carried into the Mary Ann echo.

default_outfit_tone.summary: lilac-and-white printed cotton morning dress, sleeves rolled to the elbow, long white bib apron, white cap
default_outfit_tone.silhouette_1862: plain fitted bodice, full ankle-length skirt without crinoline, long apron covering the front
default_outfit_tone.reason: 1862 housemaid's morning uniform (FAC-alice-family emblem_visual: 'a housemaid's uniform glimpsed only in family-house scenes'). Full costume by 06-art/costume.

doubling.dream_form: 'Mary Ann', the White Rabbit's housemaid; she is never seen in the dream — only named (TERM-0010)
carries_across: the white bib apron — Alice's own white pinafore is what the Rabbit mistakes for Mary Ann's apron
the white cap if any maid's cap is shown in the White Rabbit's house (e.g. hanging on a peg)
changes: her face and person never appear in the dream; the echo is carried only by the name and the apron/cap motif
doubling.quote: Why, Mary Ann, what _are_ you doing out here? / in great fear lest she should meet the real Mary Ann
doubling.reason: The apron/cap carry-over is the designed visual hinge for ruling 5.3 B; the name and mix-up are sourced.

prompt_base_en: a twenty-year-old English housemaid in 1862, auburn hair pinned under a white cotton cap, hazel eyes, round freckled face with rosy cheeks, sturdy build, lilac-and-white printed cotton dress with rolled sleeves, long white bib apron
